issues.title: Autoresponder email not sent to form leads
issues.problem_statement: The customer's form was bringing in leads, but the autoresponder email was not going out to them.

issues.title: Sender domain verification
issues.problem_statement: Support noted that emails can sometimes land in spam, so verifying the sender domain is advisable; the customer did not report a spam problem.

items.description: Support observed the autoresponder option in the form settings was switched off; the customer switched it on and saved it following support's guidance.
evidence: यहाँ ऑटोरिस्पॉन्डर वाला विकल्प बंद है।

items.description: Customer submitted a test form using their other email address, at support's request, and confirmed the autoresponder email arrived.
evidence: भर दिया... हाँ, ईमेल आ गया! अब सही चल रहा है।

items.description: Support explained that emails can sometimes land in spam, so it is good to verify the sender domain, which can be done in the email domain section of Settings.
evidence: ईमेल कभी-कभी स्पैम में जा सकता है
सेटिंग्स में ईमेल डोमेन वाले हिस्से में कर सकते हैं

items.description: Customer will verify the sender domain in the email domain section of Settings.
evidence: ठीक है, मैं कल सुबह वह कर लूँगा।

skip_recommendation.explanation: Complete support call (Hindi) with clear outcomes.
